e.title_en: UK Government Actuary’s Department (GAD): the Ogden Tables for injury and death compensation, plus official publications
e.title_hk: 英國政府精算部（GAD）：Ogden 人身損害賠償精算表等官方出版物
e.summary: 英国政府精算部门：Ogden 人身伤亡赔偿精算表（第 8 版，官方 PDF）、GAD 出版物清单、气候情景分析与公共部门养老金成本控制复核
e.summary_en: The UK government’s actuarial department: the Ogden Tables for injury and death compensation (8th edition, official PDF), the GAD publications list, climate scenario analysis and a public service pension cost-control review
e.summary_hk: 英國政府精算部門：Ogden 人身傷亡賠償精算表（第 8 版，官方 PDF）、GAD 出版物清單、氣候情景分析與公共部門養老金成本控制覆核
e.body:
**GAD（Government Actuary’s Department，英国政府精算部）** 是**英国政府的内部精算机构**（挂靠 gov.uk），为政府部门提供精算服务。本条目属本轮**养老金与退休保障数据层**——池内 **GAD 相关条目为 0**（英国侧此前有 [[ifoa]] 专业团体与 [[cmi-mortality-projections]] 等，但**政府精算部门的官方出版物入口缺位**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：GAD 机构页 `gov.uk/government/organisations/government-actuarys-department` **105KB**；**出版物清单页 `/government/publications/gad-publications/gad-publications` 71.9KB**；⭐⭐ **《Ogden tables: actuarial compensation tables for injury and death》页 79.6KB**，页面内实测到**官方 PDF 文件链接**（`assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/…/Ogden_Tables_8th_Edition_Upd…`，即**第 8 版**）；页面另实测可见 **GAD Services（服务清单）**、**Climate scenario analysis: internal data collection（气候情景分析内部数据收集指引）**、**Cost control mechanism – Government Actuary’s review（公共部门养老金成本控制机制复核报告）**、**GAD 客户反馈（2025-04 至 2026-03）** 等出版物，以及团队博客 `actuaries.blog.gov.uk`（2026-08-03 一篇关于**养老金数字韧性**）。

对 RIAA：**① 「Ogden Tables」是一件很特别的精算产物**——它是**英国法院在人身伤害与死亡赔偿中使用的官方精算表**（含**折现率与死亡率假设**），把**精算假设直接写进司法赔偿计算**；对学精算的人来说，这是**「精算表 → 法律赔偿金额」**这条链条的**教科书级实例**，池内此前没有同类条目（池内 [[payout-assurance-standard]] 是参数险赔付标准，性质不同）。**② 政府精算部门的职能清单本身有信息量**——GAD Services、公共部门养老金成本控制复核、气候情景分析指引，展示了**「精算师在政府部门做什么」**：公共养老金估值、政策成本评估、气候压力情景，对学生理解**精算的职业边界**很有用（可与 [[actuarial-outpost]]、[[actubase]]、[[dav-ai-professional-profile]] 一类职业路径条目并读）。**③ 英国公共部门养老金**（public service pension schemes）的估值与成本控制，与 [[ifoa]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[retirement-planning]] 以及池内英国条目形成互补。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**机构页、出版物清单页、Ogden Tables 页与其中一个 PDF 的文件链接**，**但未下载或打开任何 PDF**，因此**不能确认表的具体假设、折现率与版本差异**（**版本以页面所示第 8 版为准，未核对是否有更新版**）；**②** gov.uk 页面结构复杂（cookie 与导航占比较大），**本次只提取了可核实的要点**；**③** Ogden Tables **受英国司法辖区限定**，**不能直接用于其他法域**；**④** 本词条**不主张**该站提供建模工具或数据集下载服务。**核实说明**：机构页（105KB）、出版物清单页（71.9KB）、Ogden Tables 页（79.6KB）HTTP 200 实测；`Ogden_Tables_8th_Edition` PDF 链接在页面内实测可见；**未下载或打开 PDF**。
e.body_en:
**GAD (Government Actuary’s Department)** is **the UK government’s in-house actuarial department** (hosted on gov.uk), providing actuarial services to government departments. This entry belongs to this round’s **pension and retirement security data layer** — the corpus held **zero GAD-related entries** (the UK side had the professional body [[ifoa]] and entries such as [[cmi-mortality-projections]], but **no entry point to the government actuary’s official publications**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the GAD organisation page on gov.uk is **105KB**; the **publications list `/government/publications/gad-publications/gad-publications`** is 71.9KB; ⭐⭐ the **"Ogden tables: actuarial compensation tables for injury and death" page** is 79.6KB and carries a **measured official PDF link** (`assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/…/Ogden_Tables_8th_Edition_Upd…`, i.e. the **8th edition**); the pages also show **GAD Services**, **"Climate scenario analysis: internal data collection"**, the **"Cost control mechanism – Government Actuary’s review"** report, **GAD client feedback (April 2025 to March 2026)** and the team blog `actuaries.blog.gov.uk` (a post of 2026-08-03 on **digital resilience for pensions**).

For RIAA: **① the Ogden Tables are a distinctly actuarial artefact** — they are **the official actuarial tables UK courts use to assess injury and death compensation** (with **discount-rate and mortality assumptions**), placing **actuarial assumptions directly into judicial damages calculation**; for actuarial students this is a **textbook-grade instance of the "actuarial table → legal award" chain**, and the corpus had nothing comparable ([[payout-assurance-standard]] is a parametric payout standard, a different thing). **② The department’s service list is itself informative** — GAD Services, the public service pension cost-control review and climate scenario guidance show **what actuaries do inside government**: public pension valuation, policy cost assessment, climate stress scenarios — useful for understanding **the professional boundary of actuarial work** (readable with career-path entries such as [[actuarial-outpost]], [[actubase]] and [[dav-ai-professional-profile]]). **③ UK public service pensions** — their valuation and cost control complement [[ifoa]], [[cmi-mortality-projections]], [[retirement-planning]] and the corpus’s other UK entries.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the organisation page, the publications list, the Ogden Tables page and a PDF link within it**, **but downloaded and opened no PDF**, so **the tables’ assumptions, discount rates and version differences cannot be confirmed** (**the version is taken as the 8th edition shown on the page; no check was made for a newer edition**); **②** gov.uk pages are structurally complex (cookies and navigation dominate), so **only verifiable points were extracted**; **③** the Ogden Tables **are bounded by the UK jurisdiction** and **cannot be applied directly elsewhere**; **④** this entry **does not claim the site offers modelling tools or a dataset download service**. **Verification note**: the organisation page (105KB), publications list (71.9KB) and Ogden Tables page (79.6KB) were measured at HTTP 200; the `Ogden_Tables_8th_Edition` PDF link was observed on the page; **no PDF was downloaded or opened**.
e.body_hk:
**GAD（Government Actuary’s Department，英國政府精算部）** 是**英國政府的內部精算機構**（掛靠 gov.uk）。本條目屬本輪**養老金與退休保障數據層**——池內 **GAD 相關條目為 0**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：機構頁 **105KB**；**出版物清單頁 71.9KB**；⭐⭐ **《Ogden tables: actuarial compensation tables for injury and death》頁 79.6KB**，頁面內實測到**官方 PDF 連結（第 8 版）**；另實測可見 **GAD Services**、**氣候情景分析內部數據收集指引**、**公共部門養老金成本控制機制覆核報告**、客戶反饋與團隊博客。

對 RIAA：**① 「Ogden Tables」是很特別的精算產物**——**英國法院在人身傷害與死亡賠償中使用的官方精算表**（含**折現率與死亡率假設**），是**「精算表 → 法律賠償金額」**這條鏈條的教科書級實例；**② 政府精算部門的職能清單本身有信息量**（公共養老金估值、政策成本評估、氣候壓力情景），對理解**精算的職業邊界**很有用；**③** 與 [[ifoa]]、[[cmi-mortality-projections]]、[[retirement-planning]] 互補。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**機構頁、出版物清單、Ogden Tables 頁與其中一個 PDF 連結**，**但未下載或打開任何 PDF**；**版本以頁面所示第 8 版為準，未核對是否有更新版**；**②** gov.uk 結構複雜，**只提取可核實要點**；**③** Ogden Tables **受英國司法轄區限定**；**④** 本詞條**不主張**該站提供建模工具。**核實說明**：三頁 HTTP 200 實測；**未下載 PDF**。
